1.t: When the sun is shrouded in darkness,

3.t: when the mountains are set in motion,

5.t: when wild beasts are herded together,

7.t: when souls are sorted into classes,

8.t: when the baby girl buried alive is asked

9.t: for what sin she was killed,

10.t: when the records of deeds are spread open,

11.t: when the sky is stripped away,

12.t: when Hell is made to blaze

14.t: then every soul will know what it has brought about.

18.t: by the dawn that softly breathes:

19.t: this is the speech of a noble messenger,

20.t: who possesses great strength and is held in honour by the Lord of the Throne––

21.t: he is obeyed there and worthy of trust.

23.t: he did see him on the clear horizon.

24.t: He does not withhold what is revealed to him from beyond.

25.t: This is not the word of an outcast devil.

27.t: This is a message for all people;

28.t: for those who wish to take the straight path.

29.t: But you will only wish to do so by the will of God, the Lord of all people.
